cases.sentence: ___ взял себе другую жену, которую звали Хитура.
cases.translation: Abraham took another wife, whom they called Keturah.
cases.explain: Авраам is the grammatical subject of the sentence, so it takes the nominative case.

cases.translation: They are all descendants of Keturah.
cases.explain: The noun following 'потомки' (descendants of) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Авраам оставил все, что у него было, ___.
cases.translation: Abraham left everything he had to Isaac.
cases.explain: The indirect object of оставить (to leave something to someone) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Господь ответил на его ___, и его жена Ревекка забеременела.
cases.translation: The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
cases.explain: The preposition на after ответить (to respond to something) governs the accusative case here.

cases.sentence: Там Авраам был погребен рядом со своей ___ Сарой.
cases.translation: There Abraham was buried beside his wife Sarah.
cases.explain: The preposition с/со (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Два племени в ___ твоем, два народа произойдут из тебя и разделятся.
cases.translation: Two nations are in your womb, two peoples will come from you and be divided.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.
The preposition у (from/at) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Исаак молил ___ за жену, потому что она была бесплодна.
cases.translation: Isaac prayed to the Lord for his wife, because she was barren.
cases.explain: The transitive verb молить (to entreat) takes its direct object in the accusative case.

reading.ru: Авраам взял себе другую жену, которую звали Хитура.
reading.question: What was the name of the wife Abraham took after Sarah's death?
reading.explain: The text says Abraham took a wife 'которую звали Хитура' (whose name was Keturah).

reading.ru: Авраам оставил все, что у него было, Исааку.
reading.question: To whom did Abraham leave all that he had?
reading.explain: The text states Abraham left everything he had to Isaac.

reading.question: How many years did Abraham live in total?
reading.explain: The text says Abraham lived a total of 175 years.

reading.question: How many years did Ishmael live?
reading.explain: The text says Ishmael lived a total of 137 years.

reading.ru: Исааку было сорок лет, когда он женился на Ревекке, дочери Арамея Битуила и Спадан Арама, и сестре Арамея Лавана.
reading.question: How old was Isaac when he married Rebekah?
reading.explain: The text says Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah.

reading.ru: Он поклялся и так продал свое первородство Иакову.
reading.question: What did Esau sell to Jacob after swearing an oath?
reading.explain: The text says Esau swore an oath and sold his birthright to Jacob.
